---
title: "palmpeng"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
# Load tidyverse and palmerpenguins libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
  

# Create a ggplot scatter plot using the penguins dataset. 
# Plot bill_length_mm on the x-axis and bill_depth_mm on the y-axis.
# Color points by species and use geom_point with size 3.
# Add a minimal theme and clean labels.
plot <- ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = bill_depth_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Bill Length vs Bill Depth of Penguins",
       x = "Bill Length (mm)",
       y = "Bill Depth (mm)") +
  theme_minimal()

plot

```

```{r}

#create boxplot comparing flipper_length_mm across different species, faceted by island, using custom color palettes.
boxplot <- ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = species, y = flipper_length_mm, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ island) +
  labs(title = "Flipper Length by Species and Island",
       x = "Species",
       y = "Flipper Length (mm)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Adelie" = "blue", "Chinstrap" = "red", "Gentoo" = "green"))

boxplot

```

```{r}
#build a scatter plot mapping body_mass_g against flipper_length_mm, adding a linear regression trend line (geom_smooth) for each species.
scatter_plot <- ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = flipper_length_mm, 
                                            y = body_mass_g, 
                                            color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Body Mass vs Flipper Length of Penguins",
       x = "Flipper Length (mm)",
       y = "Body Mass (g)") +
  theme_minimal()

scatter_plot

```
